overview: This paper formalizes the Echo of Prompt (EOP) phenomenon in LLM reasoning through a probabilistic framework and attention analysis, proposing two methods—Echo-Distilled SFT (ED-SFT) and Echoic Prompting (EP)—to harness this behavior for improved mathematical reasoning performance.

modules.name: Data Loading and Featurization Module
modules.description: Handles the loading of mathematical reasoning datasets (e.g., GSM8K, MathQA) and the extraction of question-answer pairs. Featurizes the data for the EOP detection probe by extracting sentence embeddings of the question and the initial prefix of the reasoning trace.

modules.name: EOP Detection Probe Module
modules.description: Implements the training, validation, and inference pipeline for a lightweight binary MLP probe designed to detect the presence of an Echo of Prompt (EOP) and estimate its boundary in reasoning traces. Outputs the EOP predicate status and prefix length for downstream analysis.

modules.name: Probabilistic Cost Framework Module
modules.description: Calculates the Echo Likelihood Gap (ΔL) and Suffix-only Likelihood Gap. Takes raw reasoning traces and their echo-trimmed counterparts as input, computes the average per-token log-likelihoods under the base model, and outputs the probabilistic cost metrics associated with echoing.

modules.name: Attention Extraction and Analysis Module
modules.description: Extracts head-averaged attention matrices from specified layers of the reasoning model. Computes and aggregates attention weights from answer tokens to question tokens and answer-prefix tokens. Analyzes layer-wise dynamics to identify attention refocusing effects in middle layers.

modules.name: CoT Distillation Pipeline Module
modules.description: Manages the generation of verified Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces from a teacher model. Implements the prompting logic for echo insertion (minimally adding a restatement of the question) and echo removal (deleting the initial echo segment) while preserving the correctness of the final answer.

modules.name: SFT Dataset Construction Module
modules.description: Constructs paired supervised fine-tuning datasets (ED-SFT and normal-SFT) by combining the EOP probe predictions with the edited CoT traces. Applies filtering and verification checks to ensure the final answer matches the ground truth, outputting token-matched pairs differing primarily by the echo prefix.

modules.name: Supervised Fine-Tuning Engine Module
modules.description: Executes the supervised fine-tuning workflow for target models (e.g., Qwen3-8B, DeepSeek-Distill-Llama-8B) on the constructed SFT datasets. Manages the training loop, optimizer steps, and checkpoint saving for both ED-SFT and normal-SFT variants.

modules.name: Echoic Prompting Inference Module
modules.description: Implements the training-free Echoic Prompting (EP) strategy for inference. Intercepts the model's generation process to append a reminder phrase and the original question context, forcing the model to re-ground its attention before continuing the reasoning trace.

modules.name: Causal Intervention Testing Module
modules.description: Implements the echo reinsertion ablation experiment. Truncates failed, echo-free reasoning traces at a specified percentage, injects a standardized echo template, resumes generation, and evaluates the causal impact of the inserted echo on exact match accuracy.

modules.name: Statistical and Correlational Analysis Module
modules.description: Performs statistical validation of the EOP framework. Implements logistic regression to verify the predictive power of ΔL on correctness, and computes discriminability metrics (Cohen's d, AUC) for attention weights between correct and incorrect groups across different layer groups.

modules.name: Visualization and Reporting Module
modules.description: Generates visual artifacts for mechanistic interpretation, including layer-wise attention weight distribution plots, word-level attention heatmaps highlighting key entities in the echo, and information flow route diagrams mapping token attribution paths across layers.
